posts.title: What do the other guys on Hinge look like?
posts.description: Hinge is a Very Necessary Thing if you’re a single dude in his twenties, especially if you’re the type of person reading this blog and living in a big city. posts.title: Don't use contact forms for your service
posts.description: I don’t like contact forms and you should not rely on them for your product. They put a buffer between you and the person trying to reach you. Instead of a direct conversation, messages are dropped into a black hole and you maybe get a confirmation, maybe not. People can sniff this kind of bad user experience from far away.
